blueprint.name: AWS BNK Demo (CLI Deploy)
blueprint.description: Deploy the awsbnkctl bnk-demo topology from the Forge UI. Choose your sizing and interface pattern, then Plan to validate the rendered cluster.yaml with awsbnkctl up --dry-run (zero AWS spend), or Deploy to provision the real AWS infrastructure with awsbnkctl up --auto. Optional demo add-ons and post-deploy use-cases are available under Advanced.

estimated_cost: Plan: zero (dry-run) · Deploy: AWS usage-based (EKS cluster + worker nodes; optional BIG-IP VE / SageMaker add extra)
outcomes: Rendered awsbnkctl cluster.yaml with your chosen topology
Plan validates the config with awsbnkctl up --dry-run (zero AWS spend)
Deploy provisions real AWS infrastructure with awsbnkctl up --auto
Deployment record with streaming output in forge UI
Optional demo-layer blocks: jumphost bastion, demo TTL, BIG-IP VE migration target, SageMaker AI endpoint
Optional post-up use-case execution: awsbnkctl demo/scenarios run against the live cluster

prerequisites.description: awsbnkctl binary (linux/amd64) available in the forge worker container

optional.name: bnk_far_archive
optional.description: F5 FAR pull-credentials JSON (cne_pull_64.json), supplied as a project secret. Required for a real up --auto; omit for dry-run only.

optional.name: bnk_jwt
optional.description: F5 subscription JWT (license.jwt), supplied as a project secret. Required for a real up --auto; omit for dry-run only.

optional.name: pattern
optional.description: BNK interface pattern for the TMM dataplane

options.label: External Only
options.description: Single external ENI with host-device CNI (simplest, kernel socket)

options.label: Dual Interface
options.description: External + internal ENI with Multus and host-device CNI

options.label: SR-IOV External (experimental)
options.description: Single external interface via SR-IOV / vfio-pci (experimental)

optional.name: instance_type
optional.description: EC2 instance type for the worker node group

optional.name: kubernetes_version
optional.description: EKS control-plane Kubernetes version

optional.name: cluster_name
optional.description: Cluster name (metadata.name) — must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,38}[a-z0-9]$

optional.name: region
optional.description: AWS region (metadata.region)

optional.name: vpc_cidr
optional.description: VPC CIDR block (network.vpcCidr). Subnets are derived inside this range.

optional.name: node_desired_size
optional.description: Desired worker node count (dual-interface needs >= 3)

optional.name: node_min_size
optional.description: Minimum worker node count

optional.name: node_max_size
optional.description: Maximum worker node count

optional.name: jumphost_enabled
optional.description: Provision an EC2 jumphost (SSH bastion) inside the external dataPath subnet. Required when demo_enabled is true.

optional.name: jumphost_instance_type
optional.description: EC2 instance type for the SSH jumphost

optional.name: demo_enabled
optional.description: Mark this as a demo deployment. Writes DEMO_MODE/DEMO_EXPIRY to state.env. Requires jumphost_enabled=true.

optional.name: demo_ttl
optional.description: Demo cluster lifetime (Go duration). Expiry = staged_at + ttl.

optional.name: bigipve_enabled
optional.description: Provision a chargeable F5 BIG-IP VE for the traffic-migration demo. Incurs AWS charges and forces the dual-interface pattern.

optional.name: bigipve_instance_type
optional.description: EC2 instance type for the BIG-IP VE appliance

optional.name: bigipve_license_tier
optional.description: PAYG BIG-IP license tier — controls the AMI and feature set

optional.name: bigipve_vip
optional.description: BIG-IP virtual-server IP inside network.dataPath.external.cidr. Leave empty to auto-derive as <prefix>.10.120.

optional.name: ai_sagemaker_enabled
optional.description: Create a disposable SageMaker LMI (vLLM) endpoint on up, deleted on down. Incurs SageMaker instance charges while running.

optional.name: ai_sagemaker_model
optional.description: Hugging Face model ID for the SageMaker LLM endpoint (required when AI demo enabled).

optional.name: usecases
optional.description: Post-up demo/scenario use-cases to run after the cluster is up. Requires demo enabled (set demo_enabled=true in Advanced). 'none' = deploy the cluster only.

options.label: None — just the cluster
options.description: Deploy the cluster only; skip post-up use-case execution. Default.

options.label: All green (demos + green scenarios)
options.description: Runs awsbnkctl demo run --all (4 demos + 6 green scenarios). Recommended for demo clusters.

options.label: All (incl. AI/amber)
options.description: All demos + all 9 scenarios including amber (egress-snat, ai-token-counting, ai-semantic-cache)

modules.name: AWS BNK Demo
modules.description: Single-module CLI deploy of the bnk-demo topology via awsbnkctl

modules.name: BNK Demo Use-Cases
modules.description: Runs awsbnkctl demo/scenarios after the cluster is up (skipped when usecases=none)
